Name: Little Shop of Horrors Audrey II Pet
Author: mullberrytree
Description:
Replace dog1 with a bloodthirsty plant from outer space! Audrey II runs, sits, sleeps, and opens their mouth wide for Seymour's blood! This will also replace the dog1 portrait with Audrey II. There's currently no audio replacement so Audrey II will have the dog noises. You must have SAMPI and ContentPatcher installed.

Place unzipped folder ([CP]...) in your StardewValley Mod folder to run.

This is my first mod.
